title: Microbial Fermentation Research and Applications
summary: This cluster is centered around Microbial Fermentation, a method or tool that has been studied by several authors, including Choi H.S., Kim H.S., Park H.Y., Sawant S.S., and Sim E.Y. The research on Microbial Fermentation has explored its functional properties, impact on food, and potential for nutritional enhancement. Additionally, it has been the subject of recent developments and a review. The cluster also includes A Review, which is related to Microbial Fermentation, and Functional Properties, which are a result of the fermentation process.
